title: Turkish Kofte with Root Vegetable Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from Turkey, featuring kofte meatballs and a variety of root vegetables. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add chopped carrots, beets, and parsnips; cook for 5 minutes.
Add sliced lotus root; cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add kofte meatballs and stir to combine.
Season with paprika and cook for 10 minutes.
Simmer the stew for 20-25 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs (if desired).
